prohibited.rule: Do not make absolute purity claims.
prohibited.why: Absolute claims require specific approved evidence and may mislead customers.
prohibited.fix: Replace with a precise approved product benefit supported by a current source.

prohibited.rule: Do not use an unapproved guarantee.
prohibited.why: Guarantees must match approved legal and warranty wording.
prohibited.fix: Remove the guarantee or use the exact approved warranty statement.

terminology.why: The brand addresses people as customers.

facts.claim: AquaNest PureFlow includes a 7-stage filtration process.
